purpose: Read-only decomposition of saved Beat This OLS failures into reference context, constant-period compatibility, tempo-family and event correspondence; no new estimator or rescue of rejected candidates.

diagnostics.baseline: unchanged source-local Beat This OLS projection and score_window; exactly reproduce saved tuples, coarse/OLS per-window scores and aggregates, including 187/401 joint windows and two original coarse-to-OLS regressions
diagnostics.context: same reference envelope test as frozen scorer; report all 600 windows, but complete-context quality/triage tables use only the original 401; incomplete windows remain explicitly unknown
diagnostics.reference_constant_witness: apply the unchanged project function to reference beat/downbeat coordinates on each original window, then the unchanged frozen scorer and common one-to-one diagnostics; this uses labels and is solely a representation witness, never detector output, an optimized oracle, accuracy ceiling or candidate selection
diagnostics.reference_periods: use the unchanged nearest-five-interval local-period helper at every annotated in-window beat; preserve its exact integer/half-integer value as a Fraction; report min/median/max and local variation separately from raw annotated intervals
diagnostics.constant_period_compatibility: intersect [0.99*local_period,1.01*local_period] over every in-window reference beat; empty intersection is incompatible with the period criterion under a complete one-to-one sequence correspondence; it is not an impossibility claim for the old precision-only scorer or a proof of musical tempo change rather than annotation jitter
diagnostics.tempo_family: selected Q32 grid period divided by median annotated local period; label same_period, half_period_double_bpm, double_period_half_bpm, two_thirds_period, three_halves_period, one_third_period, triple_period only when within 1% of that fixed ratio; otherwise unmatched_ratio; absent projection/reference is unavailable; do not alter selected tempo
diagnostics.event_correspondence: each original raw in-window event maps to its nearest annotated beat in the whole source, ties to earlier; retain it only within 0.10 of that reference beat's local period; separately count phase-mismatched events, duplicate matches, matches outside the window and annotated in-window beats without a unique match; these are diagnostic mismatch indications, not manually established missing/extra musical events
diagnostics.triage_semantics: first applicable rule produces one exclusive display group; report overlapping flags, tempo families and model/witness pass cross-tab independently; a priority group is not causal proof or an additive attribution of accuracy loss
diagnostics.regressions: retain the original two coarse-to-OLS failures with all private diagnostics; publish only redacted categories/flags and witness verdicts
diagnostics.confidence: unknown/uncalibrated, no new confidence score or safety qualification
